claims.value: ERNIE 5.5 Flash is an efficient sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language model with 280B total parameters and 14B activated per token, pre-trained from scratch on 33.5T tokens. It features a hybrid-attention MoE architecture and supports a 1M-token context for fine-tuning and inference.
